近年来，华盛顿州为缓解住房危机、增加住房多样性和可负担性，连续出台了具有突破性的两项住房改革法案：HB1110（中等密度住宅法案）与HB1337（附属住宅单元法案）。

根据预测，到 2044 年华盛顿州将需要新增100万套住房，仅金县就需34万套。HB1110要求许多城市在原本仅允许独栋住宅的地区，允许更广泛的住宅类型（例如双拼屋、三联屋、四联屋、联排住宅、叠拼公寓和庭院式住宅）。

我们诚邀您参加即将在本周举行的关于“如何利用HB1110 和HB1337新政最大化土地价值？”的专题讲座。

本次讲座由5ft2 Studio Architects创办人彭碧莉和Merit Engineering工程师Alex Yu带来两项新法案的深入解读。探讨两项法案对于重塑华盛顿州传统“独栋住宅为主”的居住模式有何作用，以及对华盛顿州未来开发方向、房产投资、业主权益以及城市空间格局产生的深远影响。

 活动内容：

  • 如何利用新政最大化土地价值？

  • 如何将多户住宅嵌入原有低密度社区，兼顾隐私、绿化与日照？

  • 建设审批流程是否能同步优化？

  • 基础设施承载力（如排水、电力）是否能支撑更高密度？

华盛顿州注册建筑师。碧莉拥有20年以上的建筑专业经验和丰富的国际实践背景。碧莉在阿姆斯特丹创办了5ft2 Studio Architects，而后在西雅图扎根。如今，碧莉专注于将她过去的国际设计经验融入在本地的建筑与室内设计领域，她对于本地建筑法规和风土人情的深入理解让她得以为每个项目带来独特而有趣的视角。

items.body_en:
The ever-changing dynamics of the real estate market always capture the attention of countless people. Recently, KUOW reported that in April of this year, the number of homes for sale in Seattle exceeded the number of buyers by approximately 10%, officially moving the market into buyer's territory.

Cities such as Austin, Nashville, and Phoenix—which experienced booming construction booms—along with several cities in Florida that are frequently hit by hurricanes and flooding, are seeing home prices decline. Even with high mortgage rates suppressing demand, Miami's housing market currently has a 3:1 ratio of available homes to potential buyers. What lies ahead for Washington State's real estate market? And how should one approach real estate investment in such a market environment?

This seminar features three seasoned real estate agents and analysts with diverse life experiences across different countries and regions. The session will be conducted in both English and Chinese (bilingual) .

Seminar Topics:

  1. U.S. and Washington State real estate market trends as of June 2025

  2. Market changes in residential real estate across key King County cities: Seattle, Bellevue, Tacoma, and beyond

  3. Market opportunities in Lewis County, Washington

  4. Real estate investment strategies during a market downturn

  5. How to secure stable rental returns while maximizing property appreciation through quality real estate investments

Speakers:


Max has nearly 40 years of experience in the real estate industry, having begun his career in 1984 in Cincinnati, Ohio. He has been active in Washington State's real estate market for over 30 years. In 2021, he served as President of the Lewis County Association of Realtors and was named Realtor of the Year in 2022. Since 2015, he has also served as a City Councilmember for the City of Centralia and has previously held the position of Mayor.

Since May 2000, he has owned the Windermere Centralia office, where his team consists of dozens of licensed agents and ranks as the top-producing real estate brokerage in Centralia by sales volume.

While working in the energy trading business, Cong Zhao personally bought and sold properties in three different states—and that's when he fell in love with the real estate industry. Having lived in four different states and traveled extensively to visit friends and research local real estate markets in many more, he has developed a deep understanding of market dynamics across the country. He is always delighted to share his insights with clients and friends. Known for his attentive listening, Cong is committed to understanding his clients' needs and creating value for them.

Alican grew up in a Turkish real estate family, where he witnessed firsthand how real estate decisions can profoundly impact people's lives—shaping wealth and legacy across generations. Today, he brings that same passion to his work, delivering strategic thinking and business acumen to clients and partners alike.

With a background in Industrial Engineering, Alican has long been dedicated to optimizing complex systems to drive efficiency and deliver results. He also holds an MBA, during which he gained deep expertise in marketing and sales strategies from leading enterprises. He now applies this data-driven, strategic approach to the real estate sector.

奥斯汀、纳什维尔和凤凰城等经历过狂热的建筑热潮的城市，以及飓风和洪涝灾害频发的佛罗里达州一些城市房价正在下跌。甚至在抵押贷款利率高企抑制需求的当下，迈阿密房产市场上待售房屋数量与潜在购房者的比例已达到 3:1，华盛顿州房地产市场未来走势如何？在这样的市场环境中应该如何进行房地产投资？

本次讲座由三位有不同国家和地区生活经历、经验丰富的地产经纪人和分析师主讲，中英双语。

 活动内容  

1，2025年6月美国及华州的房地产市场变化。

2，华州King County重点城市Seattle、Bellevue、Tacoma 等地住宅地产的市场变化。

3，华州Lewis County市场机会。

4，市场下行周期的地产投资策略分析。

5，如何用优质房地产投资获得稳定的租金回报同时兼顾物业升值？

 主讲人

items.title_en: Event Preview | In-Depth Analysis of FinCEN RRE Reporting Rules and Asset Protection for Chinese American Families

items.body_en:
Event Preview | In-Depth Analysis of FinCEN RRE Reporting Rules and Asset Protection for Chinese American Families

Effective March 1, 2026, the United States officially implemented the Residential Real Estate (RRE) Reporting Rule. This regulation not only affects first-time homebuyers but also has far-reaching implications for those who hold properties through LLCs for privacy protection, or who are considering transferring properties into family trusts for wealth succession.

According to statistics, Washington State sees approximately 20,000 to 30,000 property transfers involving entities or trusts each year that are directly impacted by this new rule. Transfers that were previously considered "Mere Change in Form" under Washington State law and exempt from transfer taxes now face mandatory federal compliance reporting. Any improper reporting or failure to report may trigger severe anti-money laundering audits and criminal penalties.

The Chinese American community in Washington has a high rate of homeownership, and when residential properties are used as investment properties, they are often transferred into LLCs for risk isolation. Additionally, due to Washington State's estate tax, many families choose to place their properties into trusts to ensure smooth wealth succession. Transfers that were once classified as "Mere Change in Form" under state law—and thus exempt from transfer taxes—are now considered mandatory reporting transactions at the federal level, regardless of whether any bank financing is involved.

To address these changes, CCCWA has invited Alex Cai from Cai & Associates, along with Bowic Tse from Old Republic Title and Allison Fang from ICBC USA, to provide an in-depth analysis of the new regulations. We will explore the "misalignment" between Washington State law and federal reporting requirements, and share real-world case studies.

🔍 Expert Panel Highlights

  • Why are "internal transfers" with no monetary transaction actually the primary reporting concern?

  • Transfers between individuals, LLCs, revocable trusts, and irrevocable trusts—which are exempt and which are red-line zones?

  • How can real estate agents guide clients through compliant transactions and avoid joint liability risks under the cascading responsibility framework?

  • Reporting requirements and required documentation.

  • Financial compliance and financing: Comprehensive financing services for both new immigrants and local residents. ICBC USA will share the latest approval trends in mortgage products, commercial real estate loans, and construction loans.

❓ Attorney Cai Will Also Address These Hot-Topic Questions

  • I transferred my house into my own LLC with no money changing hands—why do I need to report it?

  • What is the fundamental difference in reporting requirements between transferring into a "revocable trust" versus gifting to a "children's trust"?

  • Why are purchases through "seller financing" or "private lending" considered cash transactions?

  • What if I don't report—how would the government know? How does the federal government achieve full transparency into asset holders?

  • Who is legally defined as the primary filer? Will my own self-reporting be legally recognized?

📍 Event Details

Venue: Lake Hills Library
15590 Lake Hills Blvd, Bellevue, WA 98007

Hosted by: CCCWA – Chinese Chamber of Commerce of Washington State

自 2026 年 3 月 1 日起，美国正式实施“住宅房地产申报规则”（RRE Rule） 。该规则不仅影响初次购房者，更深度波及通过 LLC 持有房产以保护隐私，或正在考虑将房产转入家庭信托以实现财富传承的群体 。

根据统计，华盛顿州每年约有20,000 至 30,000 件 涉及实体或信托的产权转让受到此新规直接影响。过去在华州法律下被视为“形式变更”（Mere Change in Form）且免除过户税的产权转让，现在均面临联邦层面的强制合规申报 。任何申报不当或瞒报，都可能触发反洗钱合规的严厉审计与刑事处罚 。

华州华人群体拥有住宅房比例较高，且当住宅作为投资房时，通常习惯将其转至 LLC 名下以风险隔离 。受华盛顿州遗产税的影响，许多家庭选择将房产“搬进”信托以实现财富平稳传承 。过去在华州法律下属于“形式变更”（Mere Change in Form）且免过户税的产权转让，现在在联邦眼中均属于“无银行贷款”的强制申报交易 。

为此，CCCWA华商会诚邀蔡和蔡律师事务所（Cai & Associates）蔡清律师（Alex Cai），联手Old Republic Title产权公司专家Bowic Tse (谢绍霖) 先生及工银美国信贷专员Allison Fang 女士，为您深度拆解新规。我们将探讨华州法律与联邦申报规则之间的“错位”，并分享具体案例 。

 专家团核心分享亮点 

  • 为什么“没有金钱交易”的内部转让反而是申报重灾区？ 

  • 个人、LLC、可撤销信托与不可撤销信托之间的转让，哪些是“豁免区”，哪些是“红线区”？ 

  • 房地产经纪人如何引导客户完成合规交易，避免在阶梯责任制下的连带风险。

  • 申报要求及具体资料。

  • 金融合规与融资：为新移民及本地居民提供全方位融资服务。工银美国将分享在房贷产品、商业地产贷款及建筑贷款的最新审批趋势。


 蔡律师还将为您解答以下热点问题 

  • 我把房子转进自己的 LLC，没有任何金钱往来，为什么要报？ 

  • 转入“可撤销信托”与赠与“子女信托”在申报上有何本质区别？ 

  • 通过“卖方融资”或“私人借贷”购房，为什么被视为现金交易？ 

  • 我不报，政府怎么会知道？联邦是如何实现对资产持有人的全方位穿透？

  • 谁是法律定义的第一申报人？我自己申报能否获得法律认可？
